requirements.paraphrase: Qualifications require digital-circuit foundations, verification flow, command of Verilog, and familiarity with SystemVerilog.

Ability to write verification plans/reports; CET-6 or above and technical-document reading/writing in English.

teaching_mapping.learning_task: Teaching recommendation: begin with counters, state machines, and a synchronous FIFO; explain reset, clock, and concurrency semantics, then write self-checking tests; do not replace timing reasoning with memorized syntax.
teaching_mapping.evidence: Runnable RTL, self-checking tests, normal/abnormal waveforms, and one diagnosed/fixed real defect or explicitly labeled educational injection; preserve actual conclusions when the original specifications all pass.

teaching_mapping.learning_task: Teaching recommendation: first write a small C/C++ reference model, use Python or Shell for regression automation, then separate a simple verification environment into driver, monitor, scoreboard, and other roles where tools support them.
teaching_mapping.evidence: Reference-model unit tests, regression script, fixed random seeds, and failure-reproduction command; if UVM was not executed, explicitly state that only methodology was studied.

teaching_mapping.learning_task: Teaching recommendation: decompose FIFO specifications into reset, full/empty, simultaneous read/write, boundary, and other verification points; map functional coverage and iterate on missing cases.
teaching_mapping.evidence: Specification-to-test-to-coverage matrix, regression summary, gap explanation, and defect record; 100% code coverage is not a guarantee of functional correctness.

teaching_mapping.learning_task: Teaching recommendation: each week read an English protocol/tool-document section, explain its behavior in the user's chosen working language, and write a one-page English failure-reproduction report to practice the sample role's technical-English requirement; check degree and CET-6 eligibility separately.

teaching_mapping.learning_task: Teaching recommendation: after the core verification project is stable, choose one protocol or DSP module relevant to the target role as an extension; preferred experience should not displace foundational work.
teaching_mapping.evidence: Incremental specification, actual personal contribution, rerunnable results, and remaining issues; never invent internships, tape-outs, or board tests.
